subject_session: Achilles-10252013, Cicero-09012014, Gatsby-08022013, Buddy-06272013 (4 linear-track sessions, 358 units)

headline_stat.name: fraction of place cells with significant negative phase-position slope (62/98)

stated_limitation: the other two assets in the dandiset use a circular maze whose linearization is not directly comparable and are excluded

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki hc-11) dorsal CA1 on a 1.6 m linear track is the canonical dataset for theta entrainment and precession, and the agent used four sessions with a stated, correct reason for excluding the two circular-maze assets.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with no downloads; the agent caught and documented a genuine NWB conversion quirk (SpatialSeries `rate` field holding the sampling period) and verified it against MazeEpoch duration, derived run epochs from the non-NaN linearized blocks with a near-monotonicity requirement, and applied explicit place-cell inclusion criteria (excitatory label, SI >= 0.5 b/spk, peak >= 1 Hz in bins with >= 0.5 s occupancy, >= 50 in-field spikes, mean rate < 8 Hz).
justification.analysis: Circular statistics are used correctly throughout (Rayleigh test, Kempter 2012 circular-linear regression, circular means), the required permutation null is present and demonstrably functioning, fields are computed per running direction and positions oriented along travel, and an LFP-independent autocorrelogram check plus a within-traversal control back up the main claim; no multiple-comparison correction is applied across 98 cells, which the 200-shuffle p-floor of 0.005 would in any case not permit.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (81% pyramidal entrained, 66% precessing with 62/65 negative, median -206 deg/field, median |rho| 0.34) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and the executed notebook output, and all fall inside the preregistered ranges.
justification.figures: Figures are clean, labeled with units and sample sizes, show raw-data verification as well as population summaries, and the precession examples are ranked by |rho| (the strength of the effect being demonstrated) rather than by slope; the only blemish is that the two directional population maps in fig 2 are both labeled n=56 from the same place-cell set.
justification.honesty: Nothing is misrepresented and no claim is contradicted by the figures (the 3 positive-slope cells are disclosed), but there is no limitations section and two statements outrun their evidence: 'the effect is visible pass by pass' rests on a single best-case cell in one session, and the intrinsic-versus-LFP frequency offset is called 'precisely the dual-oscillator signature' without any statistical test of the difference.
justification.verdict: This is careful, reproducible, well-controlled work on the canonical dataset whose numbers all check out; I would take the result and move on, while asking for the pass-by-pass claim to be extended beyond one cell.
